Every physical run (R-code) from the routed 3D model. Detail by zone on E10–E14; bundle sections and fill on E15.
Cable routes: route map and run schedule
Generated by tools/wiring/diagram.py from cad/fitout/wiring.py — cable IDs and lengths
match bom/cable-schedule-v0.13.csv. Measurements still [EST] until confirmed on the vehicle.
230 V work: licensed electrician only (AS/NZS 3000 · AS/NZS 3001.2). Not certified.
PLAN — front to the left, driver side up · 1:21 on A3
SIDE — from the passenger side · 1:21 on A3

Slide trunk (fixed, on the glide t
230 V cables (orange runs) never share a conduit, gland row or tray compartment
with 12 V: own grommet row, own orange conduit, separator in the slide chain.
Outside the tub every run is in split conduit on rubber-lined P-clips every
300 mm (circles on E12), into M6 rivnuts - no welding or drilling the rail flanges.
Fill = cable area / conduit area (≤ 50 % for split conduit laid in).
Lengths: routed in the model; schedule adds 10 % + 0.3 m per cable.
